descriptions.notStarted: Let's go to Pia in Henesys
descriptions.inProgress: I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearig Pia at the Henesys Park. I did her a favor and took care of the blue mushrooms before. This time, she wants to make a present for a friend in Ellinia who wants to go out on a journey. The claw that she wants to make for her consists of #b15 silver plates, 50 dragon skins, and 40 screws#k...and for the friend, she also wanted me to get back the #bRed Cape#k that Rina of Henesys borrowed. If I get her all these...am I going to be richly rewarded?
descriptions.completed: I decided to go to Rina to get the #bRed Cape#k back, which she has borrowed from Pia.
